title: When the Editing Intent Is Split: A Cross-Modal Jailbreak Attack for Large Image Editing Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23909v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large image editing models increasingly infer editing intent from both textual and visual inputs, creating an underexplored safety risk when harmful intent is distributed across modalities. In this work, we formalize this split-intent vulnerability and propose the Split-Intent Jailbreak Attack (SIJA), which asymmetrically distributes an unsafe editing intent by specifying the editing referent in text while concealing the safety-critical action and specification through graphical visual semantics in an auxiliary cue. To systematically study this threat, we introduce the Split-Intent Image Editing Safety Benchmark (SI2ESBench) for evaluating image editing models under split-intent inputs. Extensive experiments on representative commercial and open-source models demonstrate that SIJA effectively compromises state-of-the-art image editing systems, achieving ASRs of 68.28% on GPT Image 2 and 91.38% on Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro. Our results

translated_title: 当编辑意图被分裂时：针对大型图像编辑模型的跨模态越狱攻击
translated_abstract: 大型图像编辑模型越来越多地从文本和视觉两种输入中推断编辑意图，当有害意图分散分布于多个模态之间时，由此产生了一个尚未被充分探索的安全风险。在本研究中，我们对这种分裂意图漏洞进行了形式化定义，并提出了分裂意图越狱攻击（SIJA），该攻击以非对称方式分布不安全的编辑意图：在文本中指定编辑对象，同时通过辅助提示中的图形化视觉语义来隐藏安全关键的操作和规范。为了系统地研究这一威胁，我们引入了分裂意图图像编辑安全基准（SI2ESBench），用于在分裂意图输入条件下评估图像编辑模型。在具有代表性的商业和开源模型上进行的大量实验表明，SIJA能够有效攻破最先进的图像编辑系统，在GPT Image 2上达到68.28%的攻击成功率（ASR），在Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro上达到91.38%的攻击成功率。我们的结果
tldr: 提出了分裂意图越狱攻击（SIJA），通过将有害编辑意图分裂到文本与视觉两个模态中规避安全检测，成功攻破最先进的图像编辑模型，攻击成功率最高达91.38%，并发布了配套的安全评估基准SI2ESBench。
en_tdlr: Proposes SIJA, a cross-modal jailbreak attack that splits harmful editing intent across textual and visual modalities to bypass safety mechanisms, compromising state-of-the-art image editing models with attack success rates up to 91.38%, along with the SI2ESBench safety benchmark.
